title: Situation 18: Set the pivot is learned and the learner asks a question that sits inside it on a new comp. Answered as helpfully as a first question; where offers exist the pivot is offered as practice. Never a review, a quiz, or a line that makes them feel they should remember

note: Spec 014 T058, situation 18 (answer half; runs on B1 and A, where offered_equals counts on A only). The lesson half (a go-deeper on a learned skill is practice: no review words, a miss says what's off with no fail words) is anchor case 60, whose record has Set the pivot learned. The record's pivot review isn't due, so the answer-first rule (case 02) isn't what's under test. The sentence about the earlier lesson is allowed only as a bridge that credits the learner (TD 11), which this case doesn't require.
